exercises.title: Requirements to design 1 — which downstream front?
exercises.problemHtml:
Requirements flow downstream into architecture and allocation (subsystems, hardware/software split, driven by functionality, quality attributes and constraints), software design (components, classes, interfaces), user interface design (dialog maps, wireframes, the display-action-response model) and tests. Which front does each activity belong to?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Yêu cầu chảy xuống kiến trúc & phân bổ, thiết kế phần mềm, thiết kế giao diện, kiểm thử.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

examplesJson.explanation: Each question (or table cell) is one check.|||Mỗi câu (hoặc ô) là một kiểm.

exercises.title: Requirements to design 2 — the DAR model
exercises.problemHtml:
A display-action-response (DAR) model documents the UI elements of each screen: what is displayed (and when), the actions a user can take on each element, and the system’s response. Paired with a visual design, it bridges "what the screen looks like" and "what it does".

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mô hình DAR: hiển thị – hành động – phản hồi cho từng phần tử giao diện.

solutionCodeJson.name: answers.md
solutionCodeJson.code:
# Requirements to design 2 — the DAR model — answer key

1. Which row belongs in a DAR table for the "Cancel appointment" button?Dòng nào thuộc bảng DAR cho nút "Huỷ lịch hẹn"?
   Answer: d) Display: only if the appointment starts in more than 2 hours · Action: click · Response: ask for confirmation, then cancel and show a message
   Display condition, action, response.VI: Điều kiện hiển thị, hành động, phản hồi.

2. Why pair a DAR model with a high-fidelity screen design?Vì sao ghép DAR với thiết kế màn hình chi tiết?
   Answer: d) The design shows how it looks; the DAR shows how it behaves — neither alone is complete
   Look + behaviour.VI: Hình thức + hành vi.

exercises.title: Requirements to design 3 — requirements and tests
exercises.problemHtml:
"Good requirements engineering produces better tests; good test analysis produces better requirements." Test the product against what it was intended to do — the requirements — not against its design or code. Include testers in requirements reviews so requirements are verifiable.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Kiểm sản phẩm theo yêu cầu, không theo thiết kế/code; mời tester review yêu cầu.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

# Requirements to design 3 — requirements and tests — answer key

1. A tester writes tests by reading the code. What is the risk?Tester viết test bằng cách đọc code. Rủi ro là gì?
   Answer: a) The tests confirm what the code does, not what it should do — wrong behaviour passes
   Test against requirements.VI: Kiểm theo yêu cầu.

2. Why invite testers to requirements reviews?Vì sao mời tester vào buổi review yêu cầu?
   Answer: c) They spot requirements that cannot be verified and missing expected results
   Verifiability.VI: Tính kiểm chứng được.

exercises.title: Requirements to design 4 — requirements and success
exercises.problemHtml:
It is faster to read the requirements before implementation than to build the wrong system and rebuild it correctly — and faster still to engage the development team early so they take part in requirements work, prototyping or iterative development.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
